name: Research
description: Scope → Gather → Synthesize → Draft → Review, for literature and investigative work.
ongoingInstructions: Keep the research question, sub-questions and exclusions in goals/boundaries of context.json; when a new question comes in, write it there before gathering.
Settle who reads each result, in what setting, and what they must understand or decide afterwards; record it as a decision, and show one section to a reader before writing the rest.
Turn questions into tasks with slice-work (call the Skill tool with it): gathering, synthesis and writing tasks, with the dependencies between them.
Gather task by task; store sources and excerpts in artifacts/ with citations. Quality over quantity — discard unverifiable sources outright and record why.
Cross-check sources and flag conflicts; record each conclusion and its supporting grounds as a decision.
Before a write-up counts as done, verify its citations and figures section by section.
When a line of inquiry closes, call the Skill tool with retrospect and write the improvements to the research process back into rules.json.

phases.title: Scope
phases.description: Narrow the research question into an answerable scope.
aiInstructions: Write the research question, sub-questions and exclusions into goals/boundaries of context.json.
Settle who reads the result, in what setting, and what they must understand or decide afterwards; record it as a decision, and plan to show one section to a reader before writing the rest.
Turn the sub-questions into tasks with slice-work (call the Skill tool with it): one gathering task per sub-question (source types, keywords), with the dependencies between them.

phases.title: Gather
phases.description: Collect sources systematically and keep records.
aiInstructions: Gather material task by task; store sources and excerpts in artifacts/ (with citations).
Quality over quantity; discard unverifiable sources outright and record why.

exitGates.prompt: Coverage is sufficient to answer the research question

phases.title: Synthesize
phases.description: Derive positions and conclusions from the material.
aiInstructions: Cross-check sources; flag conflicts and assess credibility.
Record the core conclusions and their supporting grounds as decisions.

phases.title: Draft
aiInstructions: Produce a fully structured first draft in artifacts/draft.md (introduction, method, findings, conclusion, references).

phases.title: Review
aiInstructions: Verify citations and figures section by section, fix and finalize.
Record the final conclusions as decisions.

exitGates.prompt: Citations verified and final draft confirmed

phases.title: Retrospect
aiInstructions: Call the Skill tool with retrospect, then write the improvements back into rules.json.
